sentences.text:
Sathuri Rajeswar Rao, Karimnagar Dist vs Prl Secy, Land
Acquisition Dept, ... on 4 March, 2025
 The Honourable Sri Justice J.Sreenivas Rao
 Writ Petition No. 36640 Of 2015
Order:

entities.text:
Sathuri Rajeswar Rao, Karimnagar Dist vs Prl Secy, Land
Acquisition Dept
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
" ... to issue any writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the inaction of the Respondent No.3 in consider the representation dated 08.03.2007 given by the petitioners illegal, arbitrary and contrary to principles of natural justice and consequently direct the respondent No.3 to consider the representation dated 08.03.2007 given by the petitioner by referring the application dated 19.09.1991 to Civil Court under Section 18 of L.A. Act to civil Court for proper adjudication for enhancement of compensation..."

2. Heard learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents.
3.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the petitioner submitted representation on 08.03.2007 before respondent No.3 requesting to refer the application dated 19.09.1991 to the competent Civil Court under Section 18 the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, seeking enhancement of compensation.
In spite of the same, respondent No.3 failed to consider the said representation.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submitted that if the application dated 08.03.2007 submitted by the petitioner is still pending, respondent No.3 will consider the same in accordance with law.

5. Taking into consideration the submission made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader,
without expressing any view on the merits of the case, respondent No.3 is directed to consider the representation dated 08.03.2007 submitted by the petitioner and pass appropriate orders within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, if not already disposed of.
6. With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.

J. SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 04.03.2025 mar Sathuri Rajeswar Rao, Karimnagar Dist vs Prl Secy, Land Acquisition Dept, ... on 4 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187757712/
